camera.source: the underside of the nose at the top of the frame, tracked by template matching on every frame and smoothed over 5 frames. camera.json was not used: it has a 25 px vertical jump at frame 5 that the footage does not have (the nose moves under 4 px vertically in the whole interval); it measured the mouth opening, not the camera.
